ledger: Man in striped shirt | Standing facing camera in green-and-white vertically striped shirt | Turns left and knocks on wooden door | Consistent appearance and movement

Blue hanging jacket | Solid dark navy jacket hanging beneath a circular wooden ornament at 00:00 | Flared navy jacket with white stripes hanging from a brass hook with no ornament above it at 00:08 | Morphs in design and hardware during camera pan at 00:08

Background wall and doors | From left to right: blue jacket, wide wooden door behind man, narrow wall strip with wooden box, door with framed bird illustration | Wide wooden door and wall strip vanish; a different framed circular diagram appears directly next to the blue jacket | Background layout and artwork change inconsistently at 00:08

findings.description: From 00:00 to 00:07, the space immediately to the right of the hanging blue jacket consists of a wide wooden door behind the man, a narrow green wall strip with a mounted wooden box, and a panel with a framed bird illustration. As the camera pans left at 00:08, the wide wooden door and the narrow wall strip with the wooden box vanish completely, and a framed picture with a circular diagram appears directly adjacent to the right side of the blue jacket.

From 00:00 to 00:07, the garment hanging in the background is solid dark blue with a circular decorative medallion mounted on the woodwork above it. At 00:08, as the camera pans left, the garment morphs to have prominent white stripes along its bottom and front edge, a bright brass hook appears, and the circular medallion above it disappears.
